name: image-preview
description: Shows a thumbnail of each image you paste into Claude Code, instead of only [Image #1].

rows.title: Thumbnail height
rows.description: How many terminal rows a thumbnail may take (2 to 24).

maxColumns.title: Thumbnail width
maxColumns.description: How many terminal columns a thumbnail may take (8 to 160).

showInTranscript.title: Show in transcript
showInTranscript.description: Keep the thumbnail under the message once it is sent.

renderer.title: Renderer
renderer.description: blocks draws colored quadrant blocks and works in every terminal; kitty draws real pixels in kitty and Ghostty; auto picks.
